scope: The 24 cities in this branch's existing sample-routing catalogue; not the separate national market catalogue.

routes.name: Downeaster
routes.description: Brunswick and Portland to Boston North Station. Boston's North and South stations are separate; no through-track connection is implied.

routes.name: Northeast Regional
routes.description: Boston and the Northeast Corridor to Washington and Virginia branches, including Richmond and Norfolk. Not every train serves every branch.

routes.name: Amtrak Hartford Line
routes.description: New Haven, Hartford and Springfield. A separate service; connecting trains and boarding details must be checked.

routes.name: Empire Service
routes.description: New York via Albany–Rensselaer to western New York. Albany's Amtrak station is in Rensselaer.

routes.name: Carolinian
routes.description: New York, Richmond, Raleigh and Charlotte. Amtrak's current route directory lists this passenger corridor; the former combined Carolinian/Piedmont URL redirects to that directory.

routes.name: Palmetto
routes.description: Northeast cities to Savannah via the Carolinas. The Charleston-area station is in North Charleston.

routes.name: Silver Meteor
routes.description: New York to Miami via the coastal Carolinas, Savannah, Jacksonville and Orlando. Tampa is not inferred from this line.

routes.name: Floridian
routes.description: Chicago, Pittsburgh, Washington, Savannah and Tampa/Miami. Geometry is the federal route snapshot, not an operating timetable.

cities.name: Portland
cities.note: Amtrak train station; Downeaster uses Boston North Station.

cities.name: Boston
cities.note: North Station and South/Back Bay are distinct boarding locations. No rail link between them is drawn.

operatorGaps.reason: Official GTFS download identified; its shapes and usage conditions have not been validated for this map. No SEPTA-branded line is drawn.
Official GTFS portal documents registration/token access. No account, token or agreement was created; no NJ TRANSIT-branded alignment is drawn.
Stony Brook service confirmed on MTA's Port Jefferson station page; a permitted, validated shape is not bundled. No straight-line substitute is drawn.
Coach operators are outside this rail layer and are never rendered as railway alignments.

network.description: OneLine's sample rail network (src/data/eastCoast.ts). Each edge is drawn only along bundled NTAD Amtrak track between its two cities' stations; track beyond our cities is not shown.

lirr.name: Stony Brook (LIRR Port Jefferson Branch)
lirr.note: Station coordinates from Wikipedia (secondary source, checked 2026-10-25). LIRR track is not in the bundled federal Amtrak data, so the New York link is a dashed schematic, not track geometry.
